'''Carl Etheredge''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[December 2000 Huntsville tournament (23 December)]] on 23 December 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Monkey TIEs (SYCFA)]] and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL train to 6]], according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1574">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-huntsville-al-12-23-00d1574/ huntsville-al-12-23-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 24 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-huntsville-al-12-23-00d1574/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
